question: Should maintainers treat the merged streamed-text sanitizer as enough for this issue, or require a fresh Discord + MiMo `reasoning_content` payload capture before choosing a fix?
rationale: The adjacent main-only fix covers tagged streamed text leaks, while this issue reports untagged MiMo `reasoning_content` visible in Discord; closing or repairing without payload proof risks choosing the wrong boundary.

options.title: Require Discord/MiMo payload proof
options.body: Keep this issue open until a redacted current-main run shows provider deltas, transcript blocks, and outbound Discord payload for the reported model/config.

options.title: Accept adjacent sanitizer as sufficient
options.body: Close only if a maintainer can confirm the reported visible text came through the same streamed tagged-text path fixed by the merged sanitizer.

options.title: Open a targeted security repair
options.body: Sponsor a manual fix PR now, but require the PR to include the missing payload proof before merge.

recommendation.title: Require Discord/MiMo payload proof
recommendation.body: Keep this issue open until a redacted current-main run shows provider deltas, transcript blocks, and outbound Discord payload for the reported model/config.

likelyOwner.reason: They have the strongest recent history across both Discord reasoning delivery and OpenAI-compatible reasoning parsing.
